pages.observed: Five frames 0.0 to 0.8 s. Pale clinic desk with window onto a gray skyline and river. A monitor slides from the right edge to center showing a Visit note card with only dashed placeholder lines. Caption 'In Texas, when documentation is AI-generated,' appears from 0.6 s. Top-left label reads 'Illustration. No real clinic or screen'.

Frames 1.0 to 1.8 s. A thin dark wavy ribbon rises from the desk at lower left and bends toward the left edge of the monitor; no exam table is visible in frame, the ribbon starts beside a small dark desk object. At 1.8 s a short dark dash with a cursor appears on the Visit note page above the dashed placeholder lines. Caption unchanged.

Frames 2.0 to 2.8 s. The ribbon enters the left of the screen and becomes a line of dark rounded word marks with a cursor that lengthens across the note; an 'AI draft' pill appears above it. A small framed Texas outline appears on the wall top right. At 2.8 s orange corner brackets mark an empty box right of the draft line. Caption switches to 'who verifies the output?' at 2.6 s.

Frames 3.0 to 3.8 s. The orange corner brackets right of the draft line resolve into an empty rounded square check box and hold. A Texas state outline finishes drawing in a small wall frame top right. Monitor, keyboard and desk otherwise static. No open record tray is visible below the screen. Caption 'who verifies the output?'.

4.0 s still the s1 frame. At 4.2 s cut to a wider desk view: the monitor with the empty orange check box is smaller, upper right; below it on the teal desk an empty dashed lane labelled 'pilots'; a pen lies on the desk. Lower half of frame is dark teal desk front. At 4.8 s a paper card slides in from the left edge, partly cut off. Disclosure changes to 'Illustration. No real page or interface'.

Frames 5.0 to 5.8 s. A cream paper card headed 'UTHealth Houston post' with large 'UT Physicians' and gray placeholder lines slides in from the left and rests on the desk under the monitor. No visible dateline text. The wall Texas outline gains a small circle marker near the upper Gulf coast. The pilots lane stays empty; no unified-system outline or progress bar appears yet.

Frames 6.0 to 6.8 s. A dashed rounded box labelled 'one unified system' draws to the right of the post card. Inside, a tag 'working toward' and a horizontal bar whose dark fill grows from the left to about a quarter of its length, ending short of a dotted end marker. The box interior otherwise empty.

Frames 7.0 to 7.8 s. Post card and the dashed 'one unified system' box with its short stopped bar hold still. Caption changes at 7.2 s to 'Epic's ambient listening platform.' Only at 7.8 s does a small tilted tag, partly readable as 'Epic ambi... listening', enter at the right frame edge beside the basket, cut off by the frame.

8.0 to 8.4 s the tilted 'Epic ambient listening' tag slides from the right and settles on the top edge of the dashed unified-system box; the wall Texas frame fades away. At 8.6 s cut to a split: two stacked rounded crops on a blurred pale background; top crop is the empty dashed 'pilots' lane, bottom crop shows the 'Epic ambient listening' tag on a dashed line over 'one unified system'. Caption 'It follows pilot programs involving DAX and Abridge.' while the pilots lane is still empty at 8.8 s.

Frames 9.0 to 9.8 s in the split view. The pilots lane is empty at 9.0 to 9.2 s; at 9.4 s a tilted 'DAX' tag drops into it, at 9.6 s an 'Abridge' tag drops overlapping it, and by 9.8 s 'DAX' and 'Abridge' sit side by side in the pilots lane. The lower panel holds the 'Epic ambient listening' tag over 'one unified system'.

Frames 10.0 to 10.8 s. The split view holds unchanged: top panel pilots lane with DAX and Abridge tags, bottom panel Epic ambient listening tag over one unified system, blurred pale background. No visible motion across the five samples.

11.0 to 11.4 s the split pilot view holds; caption disappears at 11.4 s. At 11.6 s cut to a desk view: monitor with the empty orange check box upper right; on the desk a label 'physicians' over a row of six dashed, unfilled head-and-shoulder outlines; a small calendar card with a dashed blank slot is cut off at the left edge. Disclosure 'Illustration. No real people or schedule'.

Frames 12.0 to 12.8 s. The dashed physician outlines fill with solid cream from the left, one after another; by 12.6 s four are filled and the two at the right stay dashed. A small 'eventually' label with a dashed arrow appears above the unfilled right end. The calendar card at left keeps a dashed empty slot; no 'no date stated' tag is visible.

Frames 13.0 to 13.8 s. Four filled and two dashed physician outlines hold under 'eventually'. At 13.6 s a small tag enters at the left edge and by 13.8 s reads 'no date stated', hanging on the calendar card whose slot stays dashed and blank. Calendar card is partly cut off at the left frame edge.

14.0 to 14.2 s the row and 'no date stated' tag hold. At 14.4 s cut to a closer framing: physician row larger, the monitor cropped at the top of frame behind the disclosure label, calendar card and tag out of frame. Caption 'with an Epic refresher.' A small pale blank tag appears at the lower left of the row at 14.8 s, not yet readable.

Frames 15.0 to 15.8 s. A tag reading 'Epic refresher' sits under the left end of the physician row, tied by a thin string to the first filled figure. Four filled and two dashed figures hold; cropped monitor with orange box above. Caption clears at 15.8 s.

At 16.0 s cut to a closer framing of the monitor showing the empty orange check box, empty teal desk below. At 16.4 s a cream card enters from the right edge; by 16.6 s it rests on the desk reading 'Abridge release' and 'Press release'. An orange rectangular stamp lands crooked over its body lines and reads 'October 8th, 2026' at 16.8 s. Caption 'On October 8th, 2026,'.

17.0 to 17.2 s the stamped Abridge release card holds on the desk. At 17.4 s cut to a framing with the card higher and the monitor cropped at top. Caption 'Abridge announced an enterprise-wide agreement,' from 17.4 s, but through 17.8 s no agreement tag or thread is on the card; the lower half of frame is empty desk front.

Frames 18.0 to 18.8 s. A peach tag reading 'enterprise-wide agreement' with a dark clip slides in from the left and clips onto the top-left of the release card, covering most of 'Abridge release' and the start of 'Press release'. A thin dark loose thread curls down from its left end by 18.6 s. The dark clip graphic sits over the hyphen between 'enterprise' and 'wide'.

19.0 to 19.4 s the release card with the agreement tag and loose thread holds. At 19.6 s a cream card slides in from the left edge and by 19.8 s rests at lower left reading 'initiative' and 'University of Texas REAL Health AI'. The thread from the tag still hangs loose. Caption 'with University of Texas REAL Health AI.'

Frames 20.0 to 20.8 s. Release card with agreement tag upper right, initiative card lower left. The thin dark thread from the agreement tag's left end curls and by 20.8 s extends down to touch near the top edge of the initiative card; the tie is a short faint curve, small at phone size.

21.0 to 21.2 s the thread from the agreement tag runs down and ties to the initiative card's top edge with a small dot. Caption clears at 21.4 s. At 21.6 s cut to a wide room view with the window skyline and monitor; three small cream cards labelled 'UT health institution', each with a small toggle switch, sit in a row on the desk. No framework frame or access threads yet at 21.8 s.

Frames 22.0 to 22.8 s. A wide pale rounded bar labelled 'framework' with 'Abridge' beneath draws from left to right across the desk above the three institution cards; an 'Abridge says' tag attaches at its right end by 22.6 s. The bar sits close above the cards; no access threads visible yet at 22.8 s.

Frames 23.0 to 23.8 s. Framework bar and three cards hold. From 23.4 s very thin hairline threads extend from a point under the framework bar toward the cards; by 23.8 s three faint lines fan to the left, middle and right cards. The threads are short and very thin at phone size.

24.0 to 24.2 s the threads connect the framework bar to all three cards. At 24.4 s cut closer: the 'Abridge says' end of the bar with dark threads running down to two large 'UT health institution' cards, each holding a small toggle with its knob centered. At 24.8 s the left card's toggle fills peach while the right card's toggle is still gray. Caption 'preserving local decision-making.'

25.0 to 25.4 s both institution cards show peach toggles with knobs resting centered. At 25.6 s cut to the monitor in medium framing over a blurred skyline: Visit note, AI draft tag, draft line, empty orange check box. A small dark object with short horizontal lines appears left of the monitor at 25.8 s. Disclosure 'Illustration. Vendor design, not a real screen'. Caption 'Linked Evidence, Abridge says,'.

Frames 26.0 to 26.8 s. A clipped vertical paper strip of dark word-mark rows unrolls downward left of the monitor and is labelled 'source data'. Two paper tabs rise behind the top of the monitor reading 'Linked Evidence' and 'Abridge says'. The monitor keeps the AI draft line and empty orange check box. No thread yet.

Frames 27.0 to 27.8 s, wider shot with the window skyline. A thin dark thread emerges from a word mark in the middle of the draft line at 27.4 s and curves up and left, crossing over the 'AI draft' pill, heading toward the source data strip; at 27.8 s it ends at the screen's left edge, short of the strip. Thread is thin at phone size.

28.0 to 28.6 s the thread arcs from a mark in the draft line over the AI draft pill to the source data strip, and one row in the strip turns peach at 28.4 s. The thread crosses through the 'AI draft' label text. At 28.8 s cut to a close detail: large monitor with 'Linked Evidence' and 'Abridge says' tabs, the thread leaving the left edge, the empty orange check box at right; caption 'Clinicians can then verify the output.' overlaps the monitor's lower bezel.

Frames 29.0 to 29.8 s, close detail. An orange check mark floats down from above the monitor, overlapping the 'Abridge says' tab at 29.4 to 29.6 s, and by 29.8 s hovers just above the empty orange check box on the note without entering it. The thread from the draft line stays. Caption box overlaps the monitor's lower bezel.

Frames 30.0 to 30.8 s. The orange check mark stays hovering over the top edge of the empty orange check box, never placed inside it. The draft line's thread exits left. At 30.8 s the caption is gone and the keyboard under the monitor becomes visible.

31.0 to 31.6 s medium view: source data strip with a peach row threaded to the draft line, check mark hovering above the empty box. At 31.8 s a cream card slides in from the right edge reading 'Texas Act', 'enrolled bill text', 'conditions' with gray lines and a 'diagnosis' pill; its left part is behind the caption box. Bill card title shows no bill number. No effective date stamp visible yet.

Frames 32.0 to 32.8 s. The bill card now lies across the lower desk, titled 'Texas Act' with subtitle 'enrolled bill text' and a 'conditions' label; no bill number appears on the card. A crooked orange stamp lands on its right reading 'Effective September 1st, 2025'. The caption box sits over the middle of the card, hiding its gray condition lines; a 'diagnosis' pill is visible below the caption. Monitor and source strip above hold.

33.0 to 33.6 s hold of the stamped bill card with the caption box over its middle. At 33.8 s cut to a closer bill card framing: 'Texas Act', 'enrolled bill text', 'conditions', the crooked 'Effective September 1st, 2025' stamp, three gray dashed condition lines and an unlit 'diagnosis' pill, all readable; caption 'It covers artificial intelligence used for diagnostic purposes.' sits below the card. No AI tag yet.

Frames 34.0 to 34.8 s, close on the bill card. The 'diagnosis' pill changes from outlined to a peach fill starting at 34.4 s. The Effective September 1st, 2025 stamp, three gray condition lines and card title stay readable. No AI tag or frame yet.

Frames 35.0 to 35.8 s. Lit peach 'diagnosis' pill holds on the bill card. At 35.6 s a small light-blue tag enters at the card's right edge and by 35.8 s reads 'AI' at the card's lower right, about two thirds of the card width away from the diagnosis pill. No frame around the two yet.

36.0 to 36.4 s the AI tag moves beside the lit diagnosis pill and a thin rounded frame draws around both. At 36.8 s cut to a wider view: monitor with linked note and hovering check above; bill card with framed diagnosis+AI tags on the desk; at the left edge a small stack of record cards marked 'AI', labelled 'records', partly behind the bill card. Caption 'Its conditions include review of all AI-created records,'.

Frames 37.0 to 37.8 s. On the bill card the second condition line becomes a written label that types in: 'review' at 37.2 s, then 'review all AI-created records' fully readable by 37.6 s with a faint peach highlight behind it. The records stack with an 'AI' mark sits at the left edge partly behind the card; no bracket linking them yet. Text is small at phone size but legible.

Frames 38.0 to 38.8 s. 'review all AI-created records' stays readable with its peach highlight on the bill card. From 38.6 s an orange curved bracket line grows from the bill card's left edge and by 38.8 s arcs down over the records stack marked 'AI' at the left frame edge. The records stack is small and partly cut off by the frame edge.

39.0 to 39.4 s the orange bracket arcs from the bill card over the AI-marked records stack at left. At 39.6 s cut closer on the bill card: 'review all AI-created records' is large, highlighted and fully readable; the records stack has left the frame and only a sliver of the orange bracket remains at the left edge. Caption 'under Texas Medical Board standards.' No standards tag yet at 39.8 s.

Frames 40.0 to 40.8 s. A light-blue tag reading 'Texas Medical Board standards' slides in from the right and settles on the line directly below 'review all AI-created records', tied by a small string at its left end. The review line and its highlight remain fully readable above the tag in every sample. The tag covers the card's third gray placeholder line. Caption 'under Texas Medical Board standards.'

41.0 to 41.2 s the bill card holds with 'review all AI-created records' readable above the 'Texas Medical Board standards' tag. At 41.4 s a small reframe; disclosure changes to 'Illustration. No real page or seal' and caption reads 'That law is written around diagnosis.' The diagnosis pill stays inside the same diagnosis+AI frame; no new frame drawn round the word by 41.8 s.

Frames 42.0 to 42.8 s. The 'diagnosis' pill deepens to a saturated orange and an orange outline ring draws around it, separate from the AI tag. The review line and standards tag remain readable above. Camera static.

43.0 to 43.4 s the bill card with the orange-framed diagnosis pill holds. At 43.6 s cut to a split layout on a blurred pale background: the upper rounded crop shows an empty teal desk with a pen; the lower crop shows the lower half of the bill card with 'review all AI-created records', the 'Texas Medical Board standards' tag (below, not covering the line) and the framed diagnosis pill. No visit note card yet at 43.8 s.

Frames 44.0 to 44.8 s in the split. A small cream card labelled 'visit note' with an 'AI' pill and two dark draft marks slides in from the left in the upper panel and stops near center, its bottom edge at the seam above the lower panel's bill excerpt with the framed diagnosis pill. The two panels are separate crops; the note stops at the panel seam rather than at a visible frame edge. No question mark yet.

Frames 45.0 to 45.8 s. The visit note card rests at the seam above the bill excerpt. At 45.6 s an orange stroke appears at the note's upper right corner and by 45.8 s a small orange rounded tag with a '?' rises above the note. No dashed meeting line between note and diagnosis frame is distinguishable at phone size.

46.0 to 46.6 s the split holds: visit note with orange '?' tag above, bill excerpt below with the review line readable above the standards tag. At 46.8 s cut to a wide desk view: monitor with linked draft line and hovering check above; on the desk two cards, 'Abridge says / clinicians can verify' and 'Texas law / review for diagnostic use'. Caption 'Abridge says clinicians can verify.' No threads yet.

Frames 47.0 to 47.8 s. A thin teal thread starts at the corner of the 'Abridge says / clinicians can verify' card and draws upward across the monitor face, reaching the lower left corner of the empty orange check box by 47.8 s. The 'Texas law / review for diagnostic use' card sits to the right without a thread yet. Check mark still hovers above the box.

48.0 to 48.4 s the teal thread from the Abridge card ends at the empty check box. At 48.6 s the framing shifts right: monitor now left of center with the window skyline to its right; the Abridge card exits left, leaving the thread's end at the left edge; the 'Texas law / review for diagnostic use' card sits lower left. At 48.8 s a peach tag, cut off by the left edge, enters near that card. The teal desk runs fully to the right frame edge with its front face, no pale strip.

Frames 49.0 to 49.8 s. A peach tag reading 'Texas law requires review for diagnostic use' slides in from the left across the monitor and settles on the note just below the empty orange check box. A dark thread draws from the 'Texas law' card on the desk up the monitor; by 49.8 s its end meets the check box near the teal thread's end. The check mark still hovers above the box. Desk and window fill to the right edge.

Frames 50.0 to 50.8 s, static. Teal thread (from left, Abridge side) and dark thread (from the Texas law card) both end with small dots at the lower left of the empty orange check box. The peach 'Texas law requires review for diagnostic use' tag sits on the note under the box. The orange check mark hovers above the box. Teal desk extends to the right frame edge.

51.0 to 51.2 s hold of the two threads at the empty check box. At 51.4 s a small card emerges from under the monitor; by 51.6 s it hangs right of the Texas law card reading 'how well the check works' with a dashed empty box. At 51.8 s an orange stamp lands in that box, partly readable as 'not s'. The field card sits lower right of the monitor, below the screen rather than directly beside the check box.

Frames 52.0 to 52.8 s, static. The field card reads '...ow well the check works' (the leading 'h' hidden behind the monitor stand) with an orange 'not stated' stamp in its dashed box. Above, both threads end at the empty orange check box with the check mark hovering, and the peach Texas law tag sits on the note. Desk and window fill to the right edge.

Frames 53.0 to 53.8 s. Three small paper cards slide in from the left edge and settle as an overlapping stack beside the monitor stand, labels partly readable as 'UTHealth post', 'Abridge release' and 'Texas bill text'. The stack sits small at the left middle of frame, next to the 'not stated' field card. The empty check box, both threads and the hovering check remain unchanged above.

54.0 to 54.2 s the closing tableau holds with no caption: empty orange check box with hovering check, two threads meeting at it, Texas law tag, source card stack and 'not stated' field; teal desk fills to the right edge. At 54.4 s cut to a dark credits card: 'THE DAILY DISPATCH', current Lone Star flag, 'Texas AI Docket', 'Visit the Docket texasaidocket.com', SOURCES list (UTHealth Houston school post, Abridge release, Texas enrolled bill text) and ILLUSTRATION 'Original authored diagrams, no brand marks'.

Frames 55.0 to 55.8 s. The dark credits card holds unchanged: THE DAILY DISPATCH header, current Lone Star flag, 'Texas AI Docket', 'Visit the Docket texasaidocket.com' with arrow, SOURCES (UTHealth Houston school post, Abridge release, Texas enrolled bill text), ILLUSTRATION 'Original authored diagrams, no brand marks'.
Frames 56.0 to 56.8 s. The same dark credits card holds without change: Lone Star flag, 'Texas AI Docket', texasaidocket.com, three listed sources and the illustration disclosure line.
Frames 57.0 to 57.8 s. Dark credits card unchanged: flag, 'Texas AI Docket', texasaidocket.com, SOURCES list of three and the ILLUSTRATION line.
Frames 58.0 to 58.8 s. Dark credits card unchanged with flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com, three sources and illustration disclosure.

Final three samples 59.0, 59.2 and 59.233 s (frame 1777). The dark credits card is unchanged to the last frame: flag, 'Texas AI Docket', texasaidocket.com, three sources and 'Original authored diagrams, no brand marks'.
